entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts (loi n° 058-2017/AN), édition officielle 2023 à jour de la LF 2023
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes (tableau A fixed duty by turnover + 8 % of rental value)
entries.statute: CGI édition officielle 2023 (à jour LF 2023) art. 237, 239 (loi n° 042-2018/AN art. 34), 240-241; LF 2024 and LFR 2024 do not amend them; LF 2025 not held
entries.doc: art. 239 tableau A (general case), previous year's turnover excluding tax: up to 5 M 10 000 F; 5-7 M 15 000; 7-10 M 25 000; 10-15 M 40 000; 15-20 M 60 000; 20-30 M 85 000; 30-50 M 125 000; 50-75 M 175 000; 75-100 M 250 000; 100-150 M 325 000; 150-200 M 400 000; above 200 M add 100 000 F per 100 M or fraction; art. 241: proportional duty 8 % of the rental value, never below a fifth of the fixed duty.
unsupported: tableaux B (liberal professions), C (beverage wholesalers, filling stations, airtime dealers) and D (transporters)

entries.name: Zakat (as a tax)
entries.why: BF: the general tax code held (CGI-LF2023-b.txt, 1234k chars) has no zakat provision (full-text search 'zakat/zakât/zakah')

entries.name: Taxe sur les véhicules à moteur (four wheels and more, by fiscal horsepower)
entries.statute: CGI édition 2023 art. 295-1, 295-5 1) (loi n° 029-2022/ALT art. 48); LF 2024 and LFR 2024 do not amend it; LF 2025 not held
entries.doc: art. 295-5 1) vehicles with four wheels or more: up to 8 CV 7 000 F, 9-15 CV 10 000, 16-20 CV 20 000, 21-30 CV 30 000, 31-40 CV 40 000, above 40 CV 50 000.

entries.name: IRCM on dividends and other income from securities (12,5 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 140 2) (edition at 2023; LF 2024 and LFR 2024 checked: art. 140 not amended; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 140 2): income from securities (valeurs mobilières) 12,5 %, bonds issued in Burkina Faso 6 %; art. 141: half rate for the first three years of new companies.
unsupported: half rate on distributions of newly formed companies (art. 141)

entries.name: IRCM on interest on deposit and current accounts (25 % halved: 12,5 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 140 1) (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 140 1): income from claims (créances) 25 %, halved for interest on deposit and current accounts with banks, financial institutions, the Treasury and agricultural credit funds (art. 129); the household's interest is taken to be bank deposit interest.

entries.name: Impôt sur les revenus fonciers (18 % / 25 % on monthly rent after a 50 % abatement)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 125-126 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 125: net income = gross rent of the month or period less a flat 50 % abatement; art. 126: progressive bands 0-100 000 F 18 %, above 25 %. The household's annual rent is taken as twelve equal monthly rents.
unsupported: withholding of the IRF by tenants (Livre 1, Titre 1, chapitre 9, section 4)

entries.name: Taxe sur les plus-values immobilières (10 % of the gain)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 161-166 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 166: the tax rate is 10 %; the gain is the sale price less the acquisition price and costs (art. 164-165).
unsupported: flat 10 % (15 %) uplift of the acquisition price for costs and works (art. 165)
gain set at 75 % of the price when the acquisition price is unknown

entries.name: Taxe patronale et d'apprentissage (3 % of wages)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 228-229 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 228: base = all wages paid in money plus benefits in kind; art. 229: rate 3 %.
unsupported: 20 % abatement for members of approved management centres (art. 228 2)

entries.name: Contribution foncière, built property used as housing (0,1 % of cadastral value)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 270-271, 275-276 (art. 275 as amended by loi n° 042-2021/AN; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked)
entries.doc: art. 275: base = cadastral value set by the tax administration; art. 276 1): built property 0,1 % (housing) / 0,2 % (other use); art. 271: the main residence of persons effectively taxed to the taxe de résidence, or over 60, is exempt — the household's home is treated as exempt, other buildings as let housing.
unsupported: 0,2 % for buildings not used as housing (asset kinds do not carry the use)
companies subject to the taxe foncière des sociétés are exempt (art. 271)

entries.name: Contribution foncière, unbuilt property (0,2 % of cadastral value)
entries.doc: art. 276 2): unbuilt property 0,2 % of the cadastral value.

entries.name: Droit de mutation à titre onéreux d'immeubles (5 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 409-410 (art. 410 as amended by loi n° 029-2022/ALT art. 54; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked)
entries.doc: art. 410 1): transfers for consideration of immovables or real rights 5 %, on the price plus charges or an expert estimate (art. 409).
unsupported: exchanges on the higher value; sales with repurchase option 6 000 F fixed duty (art. 410 2-3)

entries.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions and gifts, tariff by bands per degree)
entries.statute: CGI 2023 art. 478 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 478: on each heir's or donee's net share, by fraction: up to 2 M / 2-5 M / 5-10 M / 10-50 M / above 50 M — direct line and spouses 0/0/1/2/5 %; siblings and third degree (uncles, aunts, nephews, nieces) 0/7/10/15/20 %; fourth degree and beyond and non-relatives 10/15/20/30/40 %.
unsupported: deduction of 100 % capped at 100 000 F per child from the third (art. 479)
otherRelative taken as 4th degree or beyond

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: BF CGI 2023 (complete code held): no tax on net wealth; full-text search for 'impôt sur la fortune', 'impôt sur le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net', 'fortune' finds only the UEMOA double-tax convention annexed

entries.name: CNSS employer contributions (16 %: pensions 8,5 %, occupational risks 1,5 %, family benefits 6 %; ceiling 800 000 F a month)
entries.statute: Décret n° 2023-0129/PRES-TRANS/PM/MFPTPS/MEFP du 24 février 2023 art. 2-6 (effective 30 Aug 2022; repeals décret 2003-252); Arrêté n° 2022-067 du 30 août 2022 art. 2 (plafond); Loi n° 004-2021/AN art. 10-11 (cnss.bf PDFs via Wayback, R4/fetch/bf11, OCR)
entries.doc: Décret 2023-0129 art. 2: 'Le taux d'appel des cotisations ... est fixé à 16 % à la charge de l'employeur selon la ventilation suivante : 8,5 % au titre de la branche des pensions ; 1,5 % au titre de la branche des risques professionnels ; 6 % au titre de la branche des prestations familiales.'; art. 3: worker 5,5 % (pensions). Arrêté 2022-067 art. 2: 'Le plafond des salaires et revenus soumis à cotisation est de neuf millions six cent mille (9 600 000) francs CFA par assuré et par an soit huit cent mille (800 000) Francs CFA par assuré et par mois.'

entries.name: Assurance maladie universelle (CNAMU), employer contribution
entries.statute: Loi n° 060-2015/CNT portant régime d'assurance maladie universelle; Décret n° 2018-0265 (CNAMU)
entries.why: the decree fixing the contribution rate was not located (press reports of Nov 2025 give 5 %, half each, with benefits from 1 February 2026; not a rate text); collection for the 2025 year not established
entries.tried: CNSS Wayback listing (no AMU text); one web search
